race.description: HKJC World Pool Bobbie Lewis Quality (G2)
race.comment: Keen to see progressive sprinter OLIVEANOTHERDAY (5) step out again. He was awesome winning the G3 The Heath at Caulfield first up, having to wait for a run but exploding once clear, the 1.5 length margin underselling the win. Beat Bridal Waltz & War Machine there and if anything this looks a shade easier. Provided he handles the straight he'll likely be winning again. LOSESOMEWINMORE (13) charged home last start in the G3 Carlyon over 1000m which isn't his go. The straight 1200m is his best trip and he drops right down in the weights - should take holding out. KING OF ROSEAU (4) resumes. He was a good winner fresh last time in and boasts a strong win over this route in similar company. Only off a short break and should go well. HEDGED (3) found 1000m too sharp fresh but is a G1 placegetter and gets in well for Shinn at a big price. ROYAL INSIGNIA (15) is going well and will be running on down the outside.
